description: This Java class defines the response for the RetrieveLoggerConfig command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages a list of LoggerConfig objects, provides JSON serialization/deserialization, and is part of the devops signals commands. The class is immutable and implements methods for creating instances, handling JSON data, and integrating with Ditto's command response infrastructure.
